units.source_text: 假若我們的真面目被馬克思主義真正的信徒識破，

en.t: If our true nature were discovered by genuine believers in Marxism,

units.source_text: 無論堀木還是我，想必都會遭到他們烈火般的怒斥，

en.t: both Horiki and I would surely be denounced by them with fiery rage,

units.source_text: 被視為卑鄙的背叛者而驅趕出他們的組織吧。

en.t: and driven out of their organization as contemptible traitors.

units.source_text: 但是，我和堀木都沒有遭受除名處分，尤其是我，

en.t: But neither Horiki nor I was expelled; I, in particular,

units.source_text: 置身於非法的世界中，居然比置身於合法的紳士世界更顯得輕鬆愉快，

en.t: found myself strangely more relaxed and at ease in the illegal world than in the lawful world of gentlemen,

units.source_text: 甚至言行舉止更為「健康」，作為前途無量的「同志」，

en.t: and even behaved in a more "healthy" way, so that I was treated as a promising "comrade,"

units.source_text: 許多重要的機密任務委派我去做，真讓人笑噴。

en.t: and was entrusted with many important secret tasks, which was enough to make me burst out laughing.
